QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] The Final Battle
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: All that remains is the final battle. At last, the time has come to defeat Magnus. Edea already succeeded in opening the throne room. Go to the #bTyrant's Throne#k and do battle with #rMagnus#k.
QuestInfo.2: You succeeded in defeating Magnus, but something strange happened and he disappeared. Not only that, the holy relic disappeared with him. Regardless, Edea said to forget it for now and enjoy victory...
